How does content marketing help generate leads?
Helpful content ranks on Google, answers buyer questions and builds authority. Paired with clear CTAs and lead magnets, it converts readers into enquiries at a lower cost than paid ads over time.
Is content marketing different from SEO?
They overlap. SEO optimises your website to rank, while content marketing creates the material that ranks, engages and converts. Strong SEO results almost always rely on quality content.
